name: taskhub
description: Gestor de tareas multiusuario - Full stack React + Express + PostgreSQL

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n server,client "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.install:all: npm install --include=dev && npm install --include=dev --prefix server && npm install --include=dev --prefix client
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --prefix server && npm run test:coverage --prefix client
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
